visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a robust, heavy-set mosasaur with a blunt, powerful head.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: High-contrast light to show the thick, rounded jaw muscles.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: A very short, rounded snout and deep jaw; none of the 'pointy' teeth typical of other mosasaurs.

pose: Side profile swimming low over a seabed of ammonite shells, highlighting the massive, crushing skull profile.
negative_constraints: No internal texture; focus only on the 'bluntness' of the head.
